overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Small-Cap 2x Daily ETF (USSX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in small-cap stocks. The fund uses swap agreements and other financial instruments to pursue 2x leveraged exposure to the daily performance of the Vanguard Small-Cap  ETF (VB), before fees and expenses. The fund does not aim to achieve 2x of the underlying ETF for any period other than a single day. USSX was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
